The camera is on the path ahead of him at the height of his chest, three long strides up the path from him, a 50mm lens. The low sun comes from the left and leaves the right side of his face in shadow. At the first frame Brigham Young fills the CENTRE of the frame from the bottom edge to the TOP third, his sandy head at the TOP CENTRE. At 00:02 he shifts the brown-backed volume from one arm to the other. At 00:04 the shingle turns under his boots, and the turn continues to the last frame of the shot. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:06 while he walks two steps up the path toward it at a normal walking pace.
